main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Processes a 5-row grid of variable width through 11 rounds of match-3 scoring and gravity compaction, accumulating points for each round until a zero width is entered." main]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> stdin </REF>: integer sequence "First integer n specifies grid width. Then n*5 integers fill the grid columns in reverse order. A zero n terminates processing."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> stdout </REF>: integer "Total points accumulated over 11 rounds for each processed grid, one per line."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read integer n from standard input. RESULT n]
            [COMMAND While n is non-zero, execute the main processing loop. RESULT loop_outer]
            [COMMAND Set point to 0. RESULT point]
            [COMMAND Initialize all elements of array a[0..4][0..19] to 0. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND For each column index i from 0 to n-1, and for each row index j from 0 to 4, read an integer from standard input into a[j][n-1-i]. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND Set m to 11. RESULT m]
            [COMMAND While m is greater than 0, execute the inner processing loop. RESULT loop_inner]
            [COMMAND Initialize all elements of array b[0..4][0..n-1] to 0. RESULT b]
            [COMMAND For each column index i from 0 to n-1, evaluate the match conditions in order. RESULT match_eval]
            [COMMAND If a[0][i], a[1][i], and a[2][i] are equal and non-zero, then check for longer matches. RESULT match_3_top]
            [COMMAND If a[2][i] equals a[3][i], then check for a 5-match. RESULT match_4_top]
            [COMMAND If a[3][i] equals a[4][i], add a[0][i] * 5 to point and set b[0..4][i] to 1. RESULT point_b]
            [COMMAND Otherwise, add a[0][i] * 4 to point and set b[0..3][i] to 1. RESULT point_b]
            [COMMAND Otherwise, add a[0][i] * 3 to point and set b[0..2][i] to 1. RESULT point_b]
            [COMMAND Else if a[1][i], a[2][i], and a[3][i] are equal and non-zero, then check for a 4-match. RESULT match_3_mid]
            [COMMAND If a[3][i] equals a[4][i], add a[1][i] * 4 to point and set b[1..4][i] to 1. RESULT point_b]
            [COMMAND Otherwise, add a[1][i] * 3 to point and set b[1..3][i] to 1. RESULT point_b]
            [COMMAND Else if a[2][i], a[3][i], and a[4][i] are equal and non-zero, add a[2][i] * 3 to point and set b[2..4][i] to 1. RESULT point_b]
            [COMMAND For each column index i from 0 to n-1, and for each row index j from 0 to 4, if b[j][i] equals 1, set a[j][i] to 0 and b[j][i] to 0. RESULT a_b]
            [COMMAND For each repetition e from 0 to n-1, for each column index i from 0 to n-1, and for each row index j from 0 to 4, if a[j][i] equals 0, shift elements a[j][i..9] left by one position by setting a[j][l] to a[j][l+1] for l from i to 9. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND Decrement m by 1. RESULT m]
            [COMMAND Print point followed by a newline to standard output. RESULT stdout]
            [COMMAND Read integer n from standard input. RESULT n]
            [COMMAND Return 0. RESULT return]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
